spec.title: Transfer applications replay original QR files, reflection adapters and FTP file types
spec.description: Prepare full original Maven modules and use real application receivers and inputs. Read a QR file through ImageIO and decode it, generate a real constructor adapter, and classify an actual file, folder and missing path through the VFS client and a loopback Apache FTPServer. The server libraries are those declared by the original project tests. Both releases see identical fixtures.
spec.expected: All three cases record their qualified observation or precise unresolved step, including original old expectation and actual method entry.
